questions.prompt: The Great Famine of the 1840s caused mass emigration from which island?
questions.fact: Potato blight destroyed the crop that much of the rural population depended on; the population fell by roughly a quarter.

questions.prompt: Which type of rock is formed by heat and pressure on existing rock?
questions.fact: Marble forms this way from limestone, and slate from shale, without either ever melting fully.

questions.prompt: In sailing, what does the term tacking describe?
options: Turning the bow through the wind
questions.fact: Because a boat cannot sail directly upwind, progress in that direction comes from a zigzag of successive tacks.

questions.prompt: Which singer's 2019 debut album was recorded largely in her brother's bedroom?
questions.fact: It swept the four main Grammy categories in one night, a feat previously achieved only a handful of times.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of the Netherlands?
questions.fact: The government and royal residence are actually in The Hague, making this a capital in name and constitution only.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the Joad family travelling to California?
questions.fact: It was publicly burned and banned in parts of California, where its portrayal of farm labour conditions was fiercely disputed.

questions.prompt: Which term describes converting data into a shorter fixed-length value?
questions.fact: A good one is designed so that changing a single character produces a completely different result.
